I’m sorry the other pair isn’t working either. Please share your user ID, registered email or phone number, and order ID. I’ll verify your account and check the refund options for that pair.
I'm not sure; I'd need to check.

No problem—take your time. I’ll need your user ID and either your registered email or phone number to verify your account.

If you can’t find the order ID, I can look up your orders after verification.
My user ID is U022, and my registered email is customer022@example.com.

I found the second pair on order O0049. It’s within the return window, and the required photo is uploaded.

The refund would be ₹3,000 to your original card; shipping was already included in the earlier ₹3,099 refund. This would bring total refunds on the order to ₹6,099, above my ₹5,000 authorization limit, so I’m referring your request to a human support agent for review.
